summary: This note is the discography overview for Shawty Lo, an American hip hop recording artist from Atlanta, Georgia. It states that his catalog consists of one studio album, one posthumous album, 15 mixtapes and 20 singles, 12 of which were as a featured artist. It also notes that he began his career with the Southern hip hop group D4L.
one_line: Discography overview of Atlanta hip hop artist Shawty Lo, covering his albums, mixtapes and singles.
